outcome: knowledge on prevention of puerperal sepsis
self-care practices for prevention of puerperal sepsis
cohort: The study included 343 postpartum women in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.
finding: More than half (62.1%) of postpartum women had adequate knowledge on puerperal sepsis prevention, but only 11.4% reported adequate self-care practices, with secondary/tertiary education and information from healthcare providers being significant determinants.
